L2Interactive Lab
Overfitting Lab — Polynomial Degree
Model jab training data ko ratne lagta hai to use overfitting kehte hain — training error kam ho jata hai, lekin naye data par error badhne lagta hai. Polynomial regression me degree badhane se model zyada flexible hota hai. Slider se degree badhao aur dekho ki training error aur validation error kaise alag behave karte hain.


TRY ITPolynomial degree badhao — train error vs validation error dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 4): Degree badhane par training error hamesha girta hai, lekin validation error pehle girta hai aur phir U-shape me upar chadhne lagta hai. Jis degree par validation error sabse kam ho, wahi model choose karo — usse zyada degree overfitting hai, usse kam degree underfitting hai.


SOURCESource: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch, O'Reilly, Chapter 4 — Training Models

L3Interactive Lab
Gradient Descent Lab
Gradient descent loss ko kam karne ka tareeka hai — har step me model loss ke gradient ke opposite direction me ek chhota kadam leta hai. Kadam ka size learning rate tay karta hai. Yahan ek simple quadratic loss par gradient descent chalao: learning rate aur steps badlo, aur dekho loss kaise girta hai ya bigadta hai.


TRY ITLearning rate aur steps badlo — loss curve dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 4): Learning rate bahut chhota ho to loss bahut dheere girta hai aur training kabhi khatam nahi hoti. Bahut bada ho to kadam minimum ko paar karke doosri taraf chala jata hai — loss oscillate karta hai ya explode ho jata hai. Beech ka learning rate sabse tez aur stable convergence deta hai.


SOURCESource: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch, O'Reilly, Chapter 4 — Training Models

L4Interactive Lab
Decision Tree Lab
Decision tree data ko sawaal-jawaab ke ped ki tarah baant-ta hai — har node par ek feature par split hota hai, aur leaf par final prediction milti hai. Max depth ped ki gehrai ko limit karta hai. Depth badhao aur dekho ki training accuracy, leaves ki ginti aur overfitting ka khatra kaise badhta hai.


TRY ITMax depth badhao — accuracy aur leaves dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 5): Gehra ped training data ko lagbhag poori tarah fit kar leta hai, lekin har leaf par bahut kam examples bachte hain to ped noise ko bhi yaad kar leta hai — yahi overfitting hai. Isliye tree ko prune karo ya max depth, min samples per leaf jaise limits lagao, aur validation score se depth choose karo.


SOURCESource: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch, O'Reilly, Chapter 5 — Decision Trees

L5Interactive Lab
PCA Lab
PCA (Principal Component Analysis) data ki dimensionality kam karta hai — woh naye axes dhoondhta hai jin par data ka sabse zyada variance hota hai. Pehle kuch components hi zyada tar information pakad lete hain. Slider se components ki ginti badlo aur dekho ki cumulative explained variance kaise badhta hai.


TRY ITComponents badhao — kitni variance bachti hai, dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 7): Components ko unki explained variance ke order me rakha jata hai — pehla component sabse zyada variance samjhata hai. Aam taur par utne components rakho jinse 95% variance bach jaye; usse zyada rakhna fayda kam, cost zyada deta hai. PCA se pehle features ko standardize karna zaroori hai.

L6Interactive Lab
Activation Functions Lab
Activation function neural network me non-linearity daalta hai — iske bina poora network sirf ek linear model hota. Har activation ka shape alag hota hai aur har ek ka apna gradient behaviour hota hai. Dropdown se function choose karo aur dekho ki input -3 se 3 tak output kaise badalta hai.


TRY ITActivation choose karo — uska curve dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 9): Sigmoid aur tanh bade inputs par saturate ho jate hain — wahan unka gradient lagbhag zero ho jata hai, isliye peeche ki layers tak gradient nahi pahunchta, ise vanishing gradient kehte hain. ReLU ka gradient positive side par 1 hota hai, isliye deep networks me yahi default pasand hai; Leaky ReLU negative side par chhota gradient rakh kar dead neuron problem ko kam karta hai.


SOURCESource: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch, O'Reilly, Chapter 9 — Introduction to Artificial Neural Networks

L7Interactive Lab
PyTorch Autograd Lab
PyTorch me har tensor operation ek computation graph banata hai, aur autograd us graph se gradient apne aap nikaal leta hai — tumhe derivative haath se likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Yahan simple function y = w*x + b lo: x aur w badlo aur dekho ki y ke saath gradient dy/dw live kaise badalta hai.


TRY ITx aur w badlo — y aur gradient live dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 10): Autograd forward pass me har operation ko graph me record karta hai, aur backward pass me chain rule se gradient nikaalta hai. Is example me dy/dw = x hai — isliye jab x bada hota hai to w ka gradient bhi bada hota hai. Training me optimizer isi gradient se weights update karta hai.


SOURCESource: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch, O'Reilly, Chapter 10 — Building Neural Networks with PyTorch

L8Interactive Lab
Dropout & Learning Rate Lab
Deep network train karte waqt do cheezein sabse zyada matter karti hain — regularization jaise dropout, aur learning rate. Dropout training me random neurons ko band kar deta hai taaki network kisi ek neuron par depend na kare. Dono sliders ghumao aur dekho ki train aur validation accuracy ka gap kaise badalta hai.


TRY ITDropout aur learning rate badlo — train/val gap dekho
Result
Usool (Chapter 11): Dropout badhane par train aur validation accuracy ka gap kam hota hai, lekin bahut zyada dropout network ko underfit kar deta hai — dono accuracy girne lagti hain. Learning rate bhi balance mangta hai: bahut chhota ho to training dheere chalti hai, bahut bada ho to loss unstable ho jata hai. Dono ko validation score se tune karo.

← PreviousL7 · PyTorch Autograd Lab→ NextInterview FAQs


F1End Matter · Interview FAQs
Interview FAQs
ML aur PyTorch interviews (current era) ke liye — fundamentals se lekar deep learning tak, 36 sawaal-jawaab. Har jawaab isi book ke concepts par aadharit hai.
Q01 Supervised, unsupervised aur reinforcement learning me kya farak hai?
Supervised learning me model labelled data se seekhta hai, jaise email ko spam ya not-spam batana. Unsupervised learning me labels nahi hote, model khud data me pattern dhoondhta hai, jaise customers ko groups me baantna. Reinforcement learning me agent actions karke reward aur penalty se seekhta hai, jaise game khelna ya robot ko chalna sikhana.
Q02 Machine learning project ka end-to-end flow kya hota hai?
Pehle problem ko samjho aur data collect karo, phir data ko explore aur clean karo. Uske baad features taiyaar karo, model choose karke train karo, aur test set par evaluate karo. Aakhir me model ko tune karo, deploy karo aur monitor karo, kyunki real duniya ka data waqt ke saath badalta rehta hai.
Q03 Train/test split kyun zaroori hai aur stratified sampling kya hai?
Test set par hi pata chalta hai ki model naye, unseen data par kaisa perform karega — training score se yeh pata nahi chalta. Stratified sampling me har category ka proportion train aur test dono me population jaisa hi rakha jata hai. Isse chhoti categories test set se gayab nahi hoti aur evaluation fair rehta hai.
Q04 Data leakage kya hai aur isse kaise bachein?
Data leakage tab hota hai jab training me aisi information aa jaye jo test time par available nahi hoti, jaise future ka target ya test set se compute ki gayi statistics. Isse model ka score bahut achha dikhta hai lekin real duniya me woh fail ho jata hai. Bachne ke liye preprocessing ko sirf training data par fit karo aur pipeline ka use karo.
Q05 Overfitting aur underfitting me kya farak hai?
Overfitting me model training data ko rat leta hai, training error kam lekin test error zyada hota hai. Underfitting me model bahut simple hota hai aur training error bhi zyada hota hai, woh pattern hi nahi pakad pata. Beech ka model chahiye — validation error se pata chalta hai ki model kis taraf hai.
Q06 Bias-variance tradeoff kya hota hai?
Bias model ki simplicity se aane wali galti hai — simple model data ka pattern miss karta hai. Variance model ki sensitivity hai — complex model training data ke noise ko bhi yaad kar leta hai. Dono ko ek saath kam nahi kiya ja sakta, isliye aisa model chahiye jahan total error sabse kam ho, aur cross-validation se wahi dhoondhte hain.
Q07 Cross-validation kya hai aur k-fold kaise kaam karta hai?
Cross-validation me data ko k hisson me baanta jata hai, har baar ek hissa validation aur baaki training ke liye use hota hai. Aise k baar train karke average score nikaala jata hai, jo single split se zyada reliable hota hai. Classification me stratified k-fold use karte hain taaki har fold me class proportion same rahe.
Q08 Gradient descent kaise kaam karta hai?
Gradient descent loss function ke gradient ke opposite direction me chhote kadam lekar minimum ki taraf badhta hai. Har step me weights ko learning rate se multiply kiye gaye gradient se update kiya jata hai. Learning rate bahut chhota ho to training dheere hoti hai, aur bahut bada ho to loss oscillate karke diverge bhi kar sakta hai.
Q09 Batch, mini-batch aur stochastic gradient descent me kya farak hai?
Batch gradient descent poore dataset par ek step leta hai — stable lekin dheera aur memory heavy. Stochastic gradient descent har ek example par step leta hai — tez lekin noisy. Mini-batch gradient descent beech ka rasta hai, ek chhote batch par step leta hai, aur aaj ke deep learning me yahi standard hai.
Q10 L1 aur L2 regularization me kya farak hai?
Dono loss me weights par penalty jodte hain taaki weights bade na hon aur model overfit na kare. L1 penalty kuch weights ko bilkul zero kar deti hai, isliye woh feature selection jaisa kaam karti hai. L2 penalty weights ko chhota karti hai lekin zero nahi karti, aur aam taur par deep learning me zyada use hoti hai.
Q11 Polynomial regression se overfitting kaise samjhein?
Polynomial degree badhane se model zyada flexible hota hai aur training error hamesha girta hai. Lekin ek point ke baad validation error U-shape me badhne lagta hai, kyunki model data ke noise ko fit karne lagta hai. Wahi degree best hoti hai jahan validation error sabse kam ho, aur learning curves se yeh point dikhta hai.
Q12 Precision, recall aur F1 score kab use karte hain?
Accuracy tab kaafi hai jab classes balanced hon, lekin imbalanced data me woh misleading hoti hai. Precision batata hai ki positive predict kiye gaye me se kitne sahi the, aur recall batata hai ki asli positive me se kitne pakde gaye. F1 score dono ka harmonic mean hai, aur jab false positive aur false negative dono mehange hon to yahi dekhte hain.
Q13 ROC curve aur AUC kya batate hain?
ROC curve alag-alag threshold par true positive rate ko false positive rate ke against plot karti hai. AUC us curve ke neeche ka area hai — 1.0 perfect hai aur 0.5 matlab model random guess jaisa hai. Imbalanced classification me ROC ke saath precision-recall curve bhi dekhni chahiye, kyunki woh zyada honest picture deti hai, khaas taur par jab positive class bahut chhoti ho.
Q14 Decision tree kaise split decide karta hai?
Decision tree har node par woh feature aur threshold dhoondhta hai jisse split ke baad groups sabse zyada pure ho jayein. Purity ko Gini impurity ya entropy se naapa jata hai. Tree tab tak split karta hai jab tak leaf pure na ho jaye ya koi stopping condition na lag jaye, jaise max depth ya minimum samples per leaf.
Q15 Decision trees overfit kyun karte hain aur pruning kya hai?
Bina limit ke tree training data ko poori tarah fit kar leta hai, har leaf par sirf ek-do example bach jate hain aur tree noise yaad kar leta hai. Pruning me ped ko kaata jata hai — ya to pehle se depth aur leaf size limit karke, ya baad me bekaar branches hata kar. Validation score se sahi depth choose karna sabse simple tareeka hai.
Q16 Random forest bagging se behtar kyun hota hai?
Bagging me kayi trees ko data ke alag-alag random samples par train karke unka vote liya jata hai, jisse variance kam hoti hai. Random forest isme ek aur randomness jodta hai — har split par sirf features ka ek random subset consider hota hai. Isse trees ek doosre se kam correlated hote hain aur ensemble zyada strong hota hai.
Q17 Boosting aur bagging me kya farak hai?
Bagging me kayi models ko parallel me alag data samples par train karke unka average liya jata hai, isse variance kam hoti hai. Boosting me models ko ek ke baad ek train kiya jata hai aur har naya model pichle model ki galtiyon par focus karta hai, isse bias kam hota hai. Boosting aam taur par zyada accurate hota hai lekin overfit aur noise ke liye zyada sensitive bhi hota hai.
Q18 PCA kya hai aur kab use karte hain?
PCA data ko un naye axes par project karta hai jin par variance sabse zyada hoti hai, aur pehle kuch components hi zyada tar information pakad lete hain. Isse dimensionality kam hoti hai, visualization aasan hoti hai aur training tez hoti hai. PCA se pehle features ko standardize karna zaroori hai, warna bade scale wale features dominate karne lagte hain.
Q19 Explained variance ratio se components kaise choose karein?
Har principal component batata hai ki woh total variance ka kitna hissa samjhata hai. Components ko variance ke order me jodte jao aur dekho ki cumulative variance kab 95 percent ke aas-paas pahunchti hai. Utne hi components rakhna kaafi hota hai — usse zyada rakhne se fayda kam aur computation zyada hoti hai.
Q20 K-means clustering kaise kaam karta hai?
K-means pehle k random centroids choose karta hai, phir har point ko sabse nazdeek centroid wale cluster me daalta hai. Uske baad har cluster ka centroid uske points ka mean bana kar update hota hai, aur yeh process tab tak chalti hai jab tak centroids badalna band na kar dein. Sahi k choose karne ke liye elbow method ya silhouette score use karte hain.
Q21 Perceptron kya hai aur woh kya seekh sakta hai?
Perceptron sabse simple neural unit hai — woh inputs ka weighted sum lekar threshold ke hisaab se output deta hai. Woh sirf linearly separable problems solve kar sakta hai, jaise AND ya OR, lekin XOR jaisi problem nahi. Isi limit ko door karne ke liye multilayer perceptron banaya gaya, jisme hidden layers aur non-linear activation hote hain.
Q22 MLP me hidden layers aur activation function ka kya role hai?
Hidden layers input ko step by step transform karke complex features banate hain, aur activation function har layer me non-linearity daalta hai. Bina activation ke poora network sirf ek linear model hota, chahe kitni bhi layers hon. Aaj hidden layers me ReLU sabse zyada use hota hai, aur output layer task ke hisaab se choose hoti hai.
Q23 Backpropagation kaise kaam karta hai?
Backpropagation pehle forward pass me prediction nikaalta hai, phir loss ko peeche ki taraf propagate karke har weight ka gradient chain rule se nikaalta hai. Yeh gradients batate hain ki har weight ko kis direction me badalna hai taaki loss kam ho. Phir optimizer in gradients se weights update karta hai, aur yeh process har batch me repeat hoti hai.
Q24 Vanishing aur exploding gradient problem kya hai?
Gehre network me gradient peeche jate jate ya to bahut chhota ho jata hai ya bahut bada, kyunki har layer par gradient multiply hota hai. Vanishing gradient me pehli layers seekhna band kar deti hain, aur exploding gradient me weights unstable ho jate hain. Isse bachne ke liye ReLU activation, sahi weight initialization aur batch normalization use karte hain.
Q25 PyTorch me tensor kya hai aur NumPy se kya farak hai?
Tensor PyTorch ka basic data structure hai, jo NumPy array jaisa hai lekin GPU par bhi chal sakta hai. Sabse bada farak yeh hai ki tensor autograd ke saath computation graph track kar sakta hai, jisse gradient apne aap mil jata hai. Tensor ko NumPy array me aur NumPy array ko tensor me aasani se convert bhi kiya ja sakta hai.
Q26 PyTorch me autograd kaise kaam karta hai?
Jab kisi tensor par gradient tracking on hoti hai, to PyTorch har operation ko ek computation graph me record karta hai. Loss par backward call karne se chain rule se har weight ka gradient nikaal kar uske gradient field me store ho jata hai. Iske baad optimizer step lekar weights update karta hai, aur agle batch se pehle gradients ko zero karna zaroori hota hai.
Q27 PyTorch me training loop ke main steps kya hain?
Pehle model ko train mode me daalo aur gradients ko zero karo, phir batch ko forward pass se guzaar kar prediction nikaalo. Uske baad loss compute karo, backward se gradients nikaalo aur optimizer step se weights update karo. Har epoch ke baad validation set par model ko evaluate karo, aur best model ko save karna na bhoolo.
Q28 Optimizer kya karta hai aur learning rate scheduling kyun zaroori hai?
Optimizer gradients ka use karke weights ko update karta hai, jaise simple gradient descent ya adaptive methods jo har weight ke liye alag learning rate rakhte hain. Training ke end me learning rate kam karne se model minimum ke aas-paas settle ho jata hai aur final accuracy behtar hoti hai. Isliye learning rate ko schedule se kam karna ya plateau par reduce karna aam practice hai.
Q29 Dropout kya hai aur training vs inference me kya farak hai?
Dropout training ke dauraan har step me kuch neurons ko random tareeke se band kar deta hai, taaki network kisi ek neuron par depend na kare aur overfitting kam ho. Inference ke time dropout band rehta hai aur saare neurons kaam karte hain, lekin unke outputs ko dropout rate ke hisaab se scale kiya jata hai. Isliye model ko evaluation se pehle eval mode me daalna zaroori hai.
Q30 Batch normalization kya karta hai?
Batch normalization har layer ke inputs ko har mini-batch par normalize karta hai, taaki unka mean zero aur variance one ke aas-paas rahe. Isse training tez aur stable hoti hai, bade learning rate use ho sakte hain aur gradient problems kam hoti hain. Yeh ek regularizer jaisa bhi kaam karta hai, isliye kabhi-kabhi dropout ki zaroorat kam pad jati hai.
Q31 Early stopping kya hai aur kab use karte hain?
Early stopping me training ke dauraan validation loss ko monitor karte hain, aur jab woh kuch epochs tak improve na ho to training rok dete hain. Isse model overfit hone se pehle hi ruk jata hai aur time bhi bachta hai. Best weights ko restore karna zaroori hai, kyunki aakhri epoch ka model hamesha best nahi hota.
Q32 Learning rate bahut bada ya bahut chhota ho to kya hota hai?
Bahut chhota learning rate loss ko bahut dheere kam karta hai aur training kabhi khatam nahi hoti, kabhi local minimum me atak bhi sakti hai. Bahut bada learning rate minimum ko paar karke doosri taraf chala jata hai, loss oscillate karta hai ya explode ho jata hai. Sahi learning rate dhoondhne ke liye alag values try karo ya learning rate finder jaisa tareeka use karo.
Q33 Data augmentation deep learning me kyun zaroori hai?
Data augmentation training images ya data ko rotate, flip ya crop karke naye examples banata hai, bina naya data collect kiye. Isse model ko zyada variety milti hai aur overfitting kam hota hai, khaas taur par jab dataset chhota ho. Augmentation sirf training data par lagana chahiye, validation aur test data ko hamesha asli rehne do.
Q34 Transfer learning kya hai aur kab use karte hain?
Transfer learning me ek bade dataset par pehle se train kiya gaya model lekar use apne chhote dataset par fine-tune karte hain. Pehli layers aam features seekh chuki hoti hain, isliye chhote data par bhi achha result milta hai aur training tez hoti hai. Jab data kam ho ya training budget chhota ho, to transfer learning scratch se train karne se behtar hoti hai.
Q35 Model ko production me deploy karne se pehle kya check karein?
Pehle test set aur real-world jaisi data par model ki performance check karo, sirf training accuracy par bharosa mat karo. Phir latency, memory aur cost naapo, aur data drift ke liye monitoring lagao kyunki real data waqt ke saath badalta hai. Aakhir me fallback plan rakho — agar model fail ho to system gracefully handle kare, aur model versioning se rollback aasan ho.
Q36 Interview me ML project ko kaise explain karein?
Pehle business problem aur uska impact batao, phir data aur uski challenges samjhao. Uske baad apna approach batao — kaunsa model kyun choose kiya, kaise evaluate kiya aur kya tradeoff the. Aakhir me result numbers ke saath batao aur yeh bhi batao ki kya galat hua aur tumne kya seekha — interviewer ko yeh sabse zyada pasand aata hai.
